name: Sakashita Chiaki
source:
A third-year student at Takizono Private Academy who served as the director of the basketball club. She comes from a wealthy family. Due to her coercive personality, she wasn't trusted much by other members. When the accident involving the whole basketball club occurred, her leading role was replaced by [url=/c580]Kazuki[/url].

[From Shiori-chan's review]
